title: 第8章  璇玑宝库
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
柳如烟看出了谢逸这是在谢莲心身上打下了护身封印，但她觉得护身封印而已，这有什么稀奇的。师尊早就给自己下过护身封印了，看来师尊还是喜欢自己多些。
“好了，没有其他事情了，你们准备一下，三日后就出发吧！”谢逸道。
“是。”
谢莲心和柳如烟走出了大殿。
————
走廊曲折，走廊四周都是奇花异草。
谢莲心走在前面，柳如烟跟在谢莲心的旁边，柳如烟细声细语地说：
“师姐，师尊没给你护身法宝和傀儡护卫，你别生气啊。主要是我修为低，师尊这才多看顾着我点，无论如何，我都越不过师姐去的。”
谢莲心双手环抱在胸前，完全没有搭理柳如烟的意思。柳如烟看到谢莲心如此，反倒是更高兴了。她继续说：
“师姐，你别这样，要不这碧心佩，还是你拿着吧？之前韩师叔已经送了我厉害的法宝护身，还有宋师叔、周师叔也送了我好些高阶符箓呢。”
“师姐，你不要讨厌我好不好？师姐，我真的很想跟你好好相处的。师姐，师姐！”
谢莲心只顾走路，柳如烟跟着她从走到了走廊尽头，又跟着她朝着后山走去，一路喋喋不休。
谢莲心很想弄死这家伙，吵死了。
走着走着，她们两个就来到了玉阳峰后山，走到了一处山洞前，山洞前面生长了许多喷香的瑶草，云雾弥漫。
谢莲心和柳如烟还没靠近这山洞，云雾中就出现了一个巨大无比的黑影，空间震颤，恐怖绝伦的威压笼罩下来。
谢莲心抬起头，丝毫没有惧色，柳如烟却是脸色都白了。
云雾中弹出了一个硕大无比的头颅，那头颅形似猿猴，这是凶兽朱厌，朱厌一见谢莲心，戾气散去，体形缩小，变成了一只可爱的小猴子，朝着谢莲心扑来。
谢莲心笑着接住了它。
“小黑，有没有想我啊？”谢莲心摸着朱厌的小脑袋，笑意盈盈的。
这山洞是璇玑宝库的入口，朱厌是镇守此地的灵兽。

这上古有名的洪荒凶兽虐杀过不知道多少强者，一般的仙人都不是它对手，后来它碰上了谢逸，被谢逸打服了，就成了谢逸的灵宠。
它是璇玑宝库的守卫，只认谢逸和谢莲心，除了谢逸和谢莲心谁都不放行。朱厌跟谢逸有血契，对谢逸的血脉很敏感，它知道谢莲心是主人的幼崽。
朱厌它思维简单，谢逸是主人，那谢莲心就是小主人。
“我进去拿点东西就出来跟你玩哈。”谢莲心将朱厌放下，朝着璇玑宝库走去。
刚刚还得意洋洋的柳如烟，现在呆愣在原地，一点喜色都没有了。
她差点忘记了，谢莲心她能随意进出璇玑宝库。师尊是没有给她法宝，可是她能自己进去拿。
她进入过璇玑宝库一次，师尊带着进去的，里面的各种宝物晃花了她的双眼。
妒忌，妒忌又疯狂地啃食她的内心。
凭什么？
同样是师尊的弟子，为什么她能随意进去？
凭什么谢莲心能够随意使用师尊的法宝？
她咬着唇，向前踏了一步，那只可爱的小猴子立即就露出了狰狞之色。
朱厌没有变成真身，但是那杀戮的戾气已经释放了出来，它龇牙咧嘴地瞪着柳如烟，似乎只要她敢再上前，它就会撕碎她。
区区一个筑基期，哪里挑战洪荒凶兽，她瑟瑟发抖，忙往后退了几步。她苍白着脸，不甘心地道：
“都是师尊的徒弟，你、你为什么只让她进去？”
“吱吱……”
朱厌冲着她龇牙，超凶的样子。
柳如烟咬着唇，那粉色的唇瓣都咬出血来了。
这畜生居然敢欺负自己，她双手握成拳头，全身颤抖。她发誓，她发誓有一天一定弄死这小畜生。
柳如烟不甘地离去了。

谢莲心已经踏入山洞，地面上散落了许多的明珠、宝石等物，许多的大箱子摆在里面，有的
这些足以让无数修士疯狂的宝贝，在谢莲心眼中不值得一提，她往里面走去，重重的禁制形成一道道光幕，浅金色的光幕如同凝固的琥珀般屏风挡在前方的道路之上，这里的禁制比护宗大阵还强，但是对谢莲心无用。
古老的血缘法禁强大无比，但有个致命弱点，就是对施术者的后代不起作用，能防住外贼，防不住家贼。
呸呸呸，怎么能说自己是贼呢？
前世去要塞历练，谢逸也没给谢莲心法宝，只在她体内打入了三道剑气。谢莲心很不高兴，觉得谢逸偏心，自己跑来这里扫荡。
现在她不会在妒忌柳如烟什么了。
前世谢莲心总以为自己聪明绝顶，她破了这里的法禁，偷偷地溜进来，师尊也不知道。每次溜进来偷东西，还特得意。
但他怎么可能不知道呢？
父亲会的上古禁制那么多，他为什么偏偏设下了这血缘法禁？明明知道她能跑进来，他为什么还设下血缘法禁，而不用其他的禁制呢？
因为这里的所有一切都是属于她的，都是为她准备的。
谢莲心走到了最里面的大门前，伸手在门上一按，白玉似的巨门之上出现了一条条的金色光线，金色的光线纵横交错，将这巨门分割成了许多的正方体，然后一个个正方体往里面凹陷，接着又如同被东西吸走了一样，狂涌后卷，消失了。
玄妙的光芒倾泻而出，里面是一个巨大无比的宫殿。
里面才是真正的璇玑宝库。
谢莲心踏入其中。
悬浮的白玉桥横贯巨大的空间，白玉桥四周都是悬浮的巨大宫灯，无数盏宫灯，如同悬浮的星辰，一盏盏宫灯里面装着一件件稀世宝物，正是这些宝物的光芒点亮了这些宫灯。
宝物的光芒映照着谢莲心的脸，她一招手，一盏盏宫灯朝着她飞来……
————
三日后。
一艘巨大的战船悬浮在云海之上，这战船上都是即将要前往佳孟关的玄天宗弟子们。
众人几乎已经到齐了，就还差一个人没有来。

宋璇剑眉蹙起，甚是不耐烦：
“谢莲心呢，她怎么还没来？”
宋璇旁边是柳如烟，柳如烟看出来众人不满，她温声道：“我出门的时候喊了师姐，可是师姐她让我先走了。”
“这个家伙总是给别人添麻烦。”宋璇气恼地说。
“师兄，也许师姐是有什么事情耽搁了吧。”柳如烟道。
“烟儿师妹，你就别为她说话了，那家伙啊，就是故意让我们所有人等她，好显得她重要的吧。”宋璇哼了一声。
content_en:
Liu Ruyan saw that Xie Yi had placed a protective seal on Xie Lianxin, but she felt that it was just a protective seal, so there was nothing strange about it. The master has already placed a protective seal on himself, and it seems that the master still likes him more.
"Okay, there's nothing else to do. Get ready and set off in three days!" Xie Yi said.
"Yes."
Xie Lianxin and Liu Ruyan walked out of the hall.
————
The corridor is winding and surrounded by exotic flowers and plants.
Xie Lianxin walked in front, and Liu Ruyan followed Xie Lianxin. Liu Ruyan whispered:
"Senior Sister, don't be angry that Master didn't give you a magic weapon or a puppet to protect you. It's mainly because my cultivation level is low, so Master looks after me more. No matter what, I can't get past Senior Sister."
Xie Lianxin crossed her arms in front of her chest and had no intention of paying attention to Liu Ruyan. Liu Ruyan was even happier to see Xie Lianxin like this. She continued:
"Senior sister, don't be like this. How about you take this Bixinpei? Uncle Han has already given me a powerful magic weapon to protect me. Uncle Song and Uncle Zhou have also given me many high-level talismans."
"Senior sister, please don't hate me, okay? Senior sister, I really want to get along with you. Senior sister, senior sister!"
Xie Lianxin just walked, Liu Ruyan followed her from the end of the corridor, and then followed her towards the back mountain, chattering all the way.
Xie Lianxin wanted to kill this guy, it was so noisy.
After walking, the two of them came to the mountain behind Yuyang Peak and came to a cave. In front of the cave, there were many fragrant Yao grass growing and the clouds were filled with mist.
Before Xie Lianxin and Liu Ruyan approached the cave, a huge black shadow appeared in the clouds and mist, the space trembled, and a terrifying pressure shrouded them.
Xie Lianxin raised her head without any fear, but Liu Ruyan's face turned pale.
A huge head popped out of the mist. The head was shaped like an ape. It was the ferocious beast Zhu Yan. When Zhu Yan saw Xie Lianxin, his anger dissipated, his body shrank, and he turned into a cute little monkey and rushed towards Xie Lianxin.
Xie Lianxin caught it with a smile.
"Xiao Hei, did you miss me?" Xie Lianxin touched Zhu Yan's little head with a smile.
This cave is the entrance to Xuanji's treasure house, and Zhu Yan is the spiritual beast guarding this place.
This famous ferocious beast from ancient times has tortured and killed countless powerful people, and ordinary immortals are no match for it. Later, it met Xie Yi, was defeated by Xie Yi, and became Xie Yi's spiritual pet.
It is the guard of the Xuanji Treasure House and only recognizes Xie Yi and Xie Lianxin. It will not let anyone in except Xie Yi and Xie Lianxin. Zhu Yan has a blood contract with Xie Yi and is very sensitive to Xie Yi's bloodline. He knows that Xie Lianxin is his master's cub.
Zhu Yan has a simple mind. Xie Yi is the master, and Xie Lianxin is the little master.
"I'll go in and get something and then come out to play with you." Xie Lianxin put Zhu Yan down and walked towards the Xuanji Treasure House.
Liu Ruyan, who had been so proud just now, was now stunned on the spot, no longer happy at all.
She almost forgot that thanks to Lianxin, she could enter and leave the Xuanji Treasure House at will. The master didn't give her the magic weapon, but she could go in and get it by herself.
She had entered the Xuanji Treasure House once, brought in by her master, and the various treasures inside dazzled her eyes.
Jealousy, jealousy gnawed at her heart crazily.
Why?
She is also Master's disciple, why can she enter at will?
Why can Xie Lianxin use Master's magic weapon at will?
She bit her lip and took a step forward. The cute little monkey immediately showed a ferocious look.
Zhu Yan has not turned into his true form, but the killing rage has been released. It glared at Liu Ruyan with its teeth bared, as if it would tear her apart if she dared to step forward again.
It was only a foundation-building period, so she was trembling and took a few steps back to challenge the fierce beasts of the wild. She looked pale and said unwillingly:
"They are all Master's disciplesBrother, you, why did you only let her in? "
"Zhizhi..."
Zhu Yan bared his teeth at her, looking very fierce.
Liu Ruyan bit her lip, her pink lips bleeding.
This beast actually dared to bully her. She clenched her hands into fists and trembled all over. She swore that she would kill this little beast one day.
Liu Ruyan left reluctantly.
Xie Lianxin has stepped into the cave. There are many pearls, gems and other objects scattered on the ground. Many large boxes are placed inside. Some
These treasures that were enough to drive countless monks crazy were not worth mentioning in Xie Lianxin's eyes. She walked inside, and the heavy restrictions formed light curtains. The light golden light curtains blocked the road ahead like solid amber screens. The restrictions here were stronger than the sect-protecting formation, but they were useless to Xie Lianxin.
The ancient blood law is extremely powerful, but it has a fatal weakness, that is, it does not work on the descendants of the caster. It can prevent foreign thieves, but not domestic thieves.
Bah, bah, bah, how can you say you are a thief?
In her previous life, when she went to the fortress for training, Xie Yi didn't give Xie Lianxin any magic weapon, but only injected three sword energy into her body. Xie Lianxin was very unhappy and felt that Xie Yi was partial, so she came here to clean up.
Now she won't be jealous of Liu Ruyan.
In her previous life, Xie Lianxin always thought she was extremely smart. She broke the rules here and sneaked in without the knowledge of the master. Every time I sneak in and steal something, I feel very proud.
But how could he not know?
My father knew so many ancient prohibitions, why did he set up this blood law prohibition? Knowing that she could run in, why did he set up a blood law restriction instead of other restrictions?
Because everything here belongs to her and is prepared for her.
Xie Lianxin walked to the innermost door, stretched out her hand and pressed on the door. Strips of golden light appeared on the giant white jade door. The golden light crisscrossed and divided the giant door into many cubes. Then each cube sunk inward, and then, as if being sucked away by something, it surged back and disappeared.
Mysterious light poured out, and inside was a huge palace.
Inside is the real Xuanji treasure house.
Xie Lianxin stepped into it.
The suspended white jade bridge traverses the huge space. The white jade bridge is surrounded by huge suspended palace lanterns. Countless palace lanterns are like suspended stars. Each palace lantern contains rare treasures. It is the light of these treasures that light up these palace lanterns.
The light of the treasure reflected Xie Lianxin's face. She waved her hand, and palace lanterns flew towards her...
————
Three days later.
A huge warship was suspended above the sea of clouds. This warship was filled with Xuantian Sect disciples who were about to go to Jiameng Pass.
Everyone is almost here, but one person is still missing.
Song Xuan frowned, very impatient:
"Where's Xie Lianxin, why hasn't she come yet? "
Next to Song Xuan was Liu Ruyan, Liu Ruyan could see that everyone was dissatisfied, she said warmly: "I called Senior Sister when I went out, but Senior Sister asked me to leave first. "
“This guy is always causing trouble for other people. "Song Xuan said angrily.
"Senior brother, maybe senior sister is delayed by something. Liu Ruyan said.
"Junior Sister Yan'er, please stop speaking for her. That guy just deliberately made all of us wait for her to make her appear important. "Song Xuan snorted.
